generations.name: First generation (STLA Large)
generations.notes: 100.5 kWh, 400 V NMC pack (same STLA Large pack as the Charger Daytona and Recon), DC peak about 160-203 kW depending on source. Only the electric Wagoneer S rows are claimed (prefix "Wagoneer S", not the gas Wagoneer). EPA and NRCan MY2024-2026. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.electrive.com/2025/11/19/jeep-recon-off-road-capable-electric-suv-to-be-launched-in-2026 ; https://www.cargurus.com/Cars/articles/2026-jeep-recon-pricing-specs-release-date
